Asset type: original project concept art for a constructible Research Workshop in an existing cartoon isometric fantasy survival / tower defense game. PREVIEW ONLY, not a finished sprite.
Primary request: ONE coherent compact research workshop, unmistakably a place for studying plans and discovering new buildings, towers and teleportation. No city or NPC scene.

No vanishing-point perspective, horizon or sky. Gentle upper-left daylight and a small soft contact shadow.
Composition: one complete centered building on a genuinely transparent RGBA background with generous empty padding around all edges. Fully show its roof, instrument and ground contacts. No broad grass/earth plate, floating island or scenery.
Constraints: original artwork, no third-party asset references, no people, no NPCs, no city, no UI, text, letters, labels, logos or watermark. No modern laboratory gear, machinery, conveyor networks, red enemy portal or blue protected throne. Do not draw a technology tree.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE original ground teleportation seal reference for a stylized isometric fantasy survival / tower defense game. New design v4. Base and discovered teleport use the exact SAME appearance.
Primary request: an attractive magical seal with a balanced geometric composition: broad circular bands, round sigil nodes, elegant connecting lines and a few bold invented glyphs. It should feel like a crafted fantasy teleport diagram, richer than plain concentric circles, yet legible in a zoomed-out game. The visual inspiration is a decorative circular occult-style geometric diagram; create an ORIGINAL arrangement and new invented symbols, not a traced or copied emblem.
Composition hierarchy: a strong double outer circular rim; six clearly spaced round satellite nodes arranged symmetrically around an inner circumference, with three larger nodes alternating with three smaller nodes so the pattern repeats with exact threefold symmetry in the ground plane. The larger nodes each contain one simple bold original curved glyph; the smaller nodes remain mostly open. At the center use a nested circular seal with two or three substantial concentric contours and an open small center. Connect the main nodes with a restrained triangular network of straight lines and three matching broad curved arc segments. Keep generous negative space and avoid a dense web. All major round shapes must remain visually distinct.
Fantasy finish: silvery ivory main strokes, very subtle pale violet secondary arcs and restrained cool turquoise glow along the lines. Slightly organic painted-light edges, clean crafted curves, softly luminous, evocative of a hand-drawn magic seal rather than a modern interface. Main circles are bolder than connecting lines, but even secondary lines must survive a small gameplay view. Only a handful of large decorative marks, no micro-lettering, rows of tiny ticks, dotted ornaments, fine calligraphy or texture. No readable words, alphabet copied from the reference, real-world religious/occult symbols, names, logo or watermark.
Orientation: the entire design is drawn FLAT on ONE horizontal ground plane. Fixed elevated ORTHOGRAPHIC tactical/isometric camera, no perspective size changes. All circles share the same foreshortening into ellipses, with symmetric equal components at opposite positions. No upright portal, arch, door, pillars, physical medallions, pedestal, hovering parts or vertical energy sheet.
Canvas: one complete centered seal on a simple quiet uniform dark muted olive-charcoal ground-color background, with generous clear margins outside the outermost strokes. Opaque concept reference. No paving details, masonry platform, moss patch, physical border, scenic objects or cast shadows. No second design or fresh/weathered variations.
Readability constraint: aim for the overall silhouette, main round nodes and central seal to read at about 128 pixels wide; ornament should support these large forms. Avoid both a bare circle-only wire diagram and an intricate close-up mandala. No bloom flooding the open spaces, noisy halos or glowing filled disks. No buildings, city, people, NPCs, UI or caption text.
